start: continue from each separate existing v31 arm with all 3 real failed proposals and their genuine public receipts

stop: per arm only on independent hidden-verified passing source, or hard infrastructure / quota exhaustion, never on a prespecified number of failed attempts

repeat_failure: adaptively reroot and provide explicit novel-approach directive; do not terminate unsolved arm or fake savings
grader: v20/v21 pinned historical Docker public, independently gated hidden after public pass; hidden details never fed back
limits: unbounded does not mean infinite API quota, time or wall clock; explicit hard infrastructure failures recorded; no claim of statistical generalizability
historical task re-use may leak training information; neither arm sees reference source

def test_url_basename(self):
        self.assertEqual(url_basename(u'http://foo.de/'), u'')
        self.assertEqual(url_basename(u'http://foo.de/bar/baz'), u'baz')
        self.assertEqual(url_basename(u'http://foo.de/bar/baz?x=y'), u'baz')
        self.assertEqual(url_basename(u'http://foo.de/bar/baz#x=y'), u'baz')
        self.assertEqual(url_basename(u'http://foo.de/bar/baz/'), u'baz')
        self.assertEqual(
            url_basename(u'http://media.w3.org/2010/05/sintel/trailer.mp4'),
            u'trailer.mp4')

def test_enumerate():
    """Test contrib.tenumerate"""
    with closing(StringIO()) as our_file:
        a = range(9)
        assert list(tenumerate(a, file=our_file)) == list(enumerate(a))
        assert list(tenumerate(a, 42, file=our_file)) == list(enumerate(a, 42))
